declaration_verdict.note: SINGLE_SOURCE_OK; relation different formulation; the auditor's reading: Naturality of the angular increment under chart rescaling of the target: the increment built from the normalized target in one chart equals the rescaling of the increment built in another, which is the (8.17) row-by-row normalization clause.

theorem rankAngular_scale {l u ell U : ℝ} (hl : l ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (hell : ell ≠ 0) (hU : U ≠ 0) (lam C a b : ℝ) (d : MeanRankUpdate.Debt) (r : ℝ) :
    MeanRankUpdate.angularIncrement lam C a b (l * ell) (u * U)
      (MeanRankUpdate.scaleDebt l u d) (l * r) =
        u * MeanRankUpdate.angularIncrement lam C a b ell U d r
